title: Distributed Systems
description: Can reason about replication, consistency and fault tolerance on a network that fails — and can make a stated anomaly appear and disappear on demand.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can run a leader and a follower as separate processes, state what a leader-only ack guarantees, and name the consistency model of a given read mode — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can reproduce a stale read under a relaxed mode and its absence under a strict mode, write the acknowledgment rule (leader-only versus quorum), and keep failure assumptions explicit — no 'network is reliable'.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently add quorum writes and an epoch or fencing token, script a split-brain overwrite that fencing then refuses, and state N, W and R with W + R > N.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a two-leader observation as a safety violation or a stale term, document idempotency and compensation limits on a retryable workflow, and produce a failure-test suite another engineer can run without opening a paper.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's replica or saga, name a write acknowledged before a majority apply (or a retry without duplicate semantics), and teach when to trust a quorum read over a leader-only read on an unfamiliar store.
